service.description: Create an authenticated session from username/password and return the explicit Moqui login-key token darpan-ui sends on later requests.

parameter.name: username
parameter.description: Account username used for login.

parameter.name: password
parameter.description: Account password used for login.

parameter.name: ok
parameter.description: True when the login attempt completed without facade errors.

parameter.name: messages
parameter.description: Informational messages emitted during login handling.

parameter.name: errors
parameter.description: Validation or authentication errors for the login attempt.

parameter.name: authenticated
parameter.description: True when the session is authenticated after the login attempt.

parameter.name: passwordChangeRequired
parameter.description: True when the submitted credentials were correct but the account cannot sign in until its password is changed. darpan-ui offers change#ExpiredPassword instead of a plain login failure. NOTE this case returns ok=true with authenticated=false and the explanation in `messages`: the credentials were accepted and the call completed, it is the session that is withheld pending a required next step. Read `authenticated`, never `ok`, to decide whether a session exists.

parameter.name: passwordChangeReason
parameter.description: Why the password must change: `PWDCHG` when the account is flagged to change at next login, `PWDTIM` when the current password has aged past the configured rotation window. Absent unless passwordChangeRequired is true.

parameter.name: twoFactorRequired
parameter.description: DAR-BE-264. True when the password was right and the account has two-factor on: no session yet. ok=true, authenticated=false; send challengeToken with a code to verify#SignInCode.

parameter.name: twoFactorSetupRequired
parameter.description: DAR-BE-264. True when the password was right and two-factor is required for the account's role but not set up: no session yet. ok=true, authenticated=false; challengeToken allows only begin#TwoFactorSetup and confirm#TwoFactorSetup, and confirm signs in.

parameter.name: challengeToken
parameter.description: DAR-BE-264. With twoFactorRequired or twoFactorSetupRequired: the sign-in challenge. Keep it in page memory only (never storage or a cookie); a refresh goes back to the password step.

parameter.name: challengeExpiresInSeconds
parameter.description: DAR-BE-264. Seconds the challenge lives: 300.

parameter.name: twoFactorMethods
parameter.description: DAR-BE-270. With twoFactorRequired: what this person can answer with here, "app" (a code to verify#SignInCode) and/or "passkey" (begin#PasskeySignIn, then the assertion to verify#SignInCode).

parameter.name: authToken
parameter.description: Explicit login-key token that darpan-ui sends on later requests through the `login_key` header.

parameter.name: authTokenType
parameter.description: Token scheme identifier. Current value: `LOGIN_KEY`.

parameter.name: authTokenHeaderName
parameter.description: Request header name darpan-ui must send for stateless auth. Current value: `login_key`.

parameter.name: authTokenExpiresInSeconds
parameter.description: Approximate token lifetime in seconds, derived from the Moqui login-key expiry.

parameter.name: sessionInfo
parameter.description: Authenticated session metadata returned to darpan-ui.

service.description: Change the password of an account that cannot sign in until it is changed, without a session. Requires the account's current password, so it grants nothing to a caller who does not already hold valid credentials. Issues no token: darpan-ui calls login#Session afterwards with the new password.

parameter.name: username
parameter.description: Account whose password is being changed. Matched exactly first, then case-insensitively, the same way login resolves an account.

parameter.name: currentPassword
parameter.description: The account's existing password, including the temporary one an admin issued.

parameter.name: newPassword
parameter.description: The replacement password, subject to the standard Moqui password policy.

parameter.name: newPasswordVerify
parameter.description: Confirmation value for the new password.

parameter.name: ok
parameter.description: True when the password update completed without facade errors.

parameter.name: messages
parameter.description: Informational messages emitted during password update handling.

parameter.name: errors
parameter.description: Errors returned while validating or changing the password. Identity and credential failures are collapsed into one indistinguishable message; password-policy failures are reported in full so the user can correct them.

parameter.name: passwordUpdated
parameter.description: True when the password was changed and the account can now sign in.

service.description: DAR-BE-028. Email a 6-digit password reset code to the account's email on file, and say what happened in outcome (DAR-UI-084). This reveals which usernames exist and have an email, by choice. The code expires in 15 minutes; requesting again replaces it.

parameter.name: usernameOrEmail
parameter.description: Username (matched exactly, then case-insensitively, as login does) or the account's email.

parameter.name: ok
parameter.description: True when the call completed without facade errors.

parameter.name: messages
parameter.description: Informational messages; always empty for this service.

parameter.name: errors
parameter.description: Always empty: what happened is in outcome.

parameter.name: outcome
parameter.description: sent, noAccount, locked (disabled or locked out), noEmail (no email on file), overLimit (3 codes this hour for the account, or 20 from the IP), or sendFailed (the mail server refused it).

parameter.name: emailAddressMasked
parameter.description: The address the code went to, masked (a•••@example.com). Set only when outcome is sent.

service.description: DAR-BE-028. Check an emailed reset code without using it up, so darpan-ui can confirm it before asking for the new password. Five wrong guesses end the code. Wrong guesses never count as failed logins.

parameter.name: usernameOrEmail
parameter.description: The same value the code was requested with.

parameter.name: code
parameter.description: The emailed code; spaces and other non-digits are ignored.

parameter.name: ok
parameter.description: True when the call completed without facade errors.

parameter.name: messages
parameter.description: Informational messages; always empty for this service.

parameter.name: errors
parameter.description: One message for every failure (no account, no live code, wrong, expired, used up): That code didn't work. Request a new one.

parameter.name: verified
parameter.description: True when the code is live and correct for the account.

service.description: DAR-BE-028. Set a new password with an emailed reset code, then sign the account out on every device and email it that the password changed. Issues no token: darpan-ui calls login#Session afterwards with the new password. A disabled account is refused and stays disabled.

parameter.name: usernameOrEmail
parameter.description: The same value the code was requested with.

parameter.name: code
parameter.description: The emailed code; spaces and other non-digits are ignored.

parameter.name: newPassword
parameter.description: The replacement password, subject to the standard Moqui password policy.

parameter.name: newPasswordVerify
parameter.description: Confirmation value for the new password.

parameter.name: ok
parameter.description: True when the call completed without facade errors.

parameter.name: messages
parameter.description: Informational messages; always empty for this service.

parameter.name: errors
parameter.description: Password-policy reasons in full when the new password was refused; otherwise the one code message: That code didn't work. Request a new one.

parameter.name: passwordUpdated
parameter.description: True when the password was changed and the account can now sign in with it.

service.description: DAR-BE-028. Save the signed-in user's recovery email, where password reset codes go. parameter.name: currentPassword

service.description: DAR-BE-264. Finish a sign-in login#Session answered with twoFactorRequired: the challengeToken with a current authenticator code, a recovery code, or (DAR-BE-270) a passkey assertion over begin#PasskeySignIn's options. Success answers as login#Session does (a session and its key). A refused passkey reads "That passkey didn't work.", counts against the challenge and is not a failed login. Every refusal is "That code didn't work."; 5 wrong codes end the challenge (challengeEnded), and each wrong code also counts as a failed login. A used recovery code emails the person. A refusal is a completed call with ok false and the reason in errors (not a JSON-RPC error), so challengeEnded reaches the caller.

parameter.name: challengeToken
parameter.description: From login#Session.

parameter.name: code
parameter.description: The 6-digit code from the authenticator app; spaces ignored.

parameter.name: recoveryCode
parameter.description: Instead of code: a recovery code, xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx (case, spaces and dashes ignored). Used once.

parameter.name: passkeyAssertion
parameter.description: DAR-BE-270. Instead of code: JSON.stringify(credential.toJSON()) of the navigator.credentials.get() result for begin#PasskeySignIn's publicKeyOptions.

parameter.name: ok
parameter.description: True when the call completed without facade errors.

parameter.name: messages
parameter.description: Informational messages.

parameter.name: errors
parameter.description: Why it was refused.

parameter.name: authenticated
parameter.description: True when a session was issued.

parameter.name: authToken
parameter.description: The login key darpan-ui sends in the `login_key` header (also set as the persistent-login cookie).

parameter.name: authTokenType
parameter.description: `LOGIN_KEY`.

parameter.name: authTokenHeaderName
parameter.description: `login_key`.

parameter.name: authTokenExpiresInSeconds
parameter.description: The sign-in's absolute lifetime in seconds, as login#Session.

parameter.name: sessionInfo
parameter.description: As login#Session's sessionInfo.

parameter.name: recoveryCodesLeft
parameter.description: With a recovery code: how many are left. At 3 or fewer darpan-ui asks for new ones.

parameter.name: challengeEnded
parameter.description: True when the challenge can no longer be used (expired, used, 5 wrong codes): go back to the password.

service.description: DAR-BE-264. Start setting up an authenticator app: a new secret (any earlier unfinished setup ends), shown once. Either signed in (a first setup needs currentPassword; replacing an app that is on needs a current code from it), or with a setup challengeToken from login#Session (twoFactorSetupRequired). Finish within 15 minutes with confirm#TwoFactorSetup. A refusal is a completed call with ok false and the reason in errors (not a JSON-RPC error); through a challenge it carries challengeEnded.

parameter.description: DAR-BE-270. Signed in, with two-factor on: instead of code, a passkey assertion over begin#PasskeyProof's options.

parameter.name: messages
parameter.description: Informational messages.

parameter.name: errors
parameter.description: Why it was refused.

parameter.name: secret
parameter.description: The key, Base32 (show grouped in fours for typing). In this reply only; never returned again.

parameter.name: otpauthUri
parameter.description: otpauth://totp/Darpan:username?secret=...&issuer=Darpan&digits=6&period=30&algorithm=SHA1 (issuer from DARPAN_TOTP_ISSUER, e.g. "Darpan UAT").

parameter.description: The otpauthUri as a QR code: an SVG data URI (data:image/svg+xml;base64,...) for an img src.

parameter.name: expiresInSeconds
parameter.description: Seconds left to confirm: 900.

parameter.name: challengeEnded
parameter.description: With a challengeToken: true when it can no longer be used (expired, used, 5 wrong codes): go back to the password.
